overall_summary: Analysis of the historical data reveals a clear outperformance of relationship and marital dynamic themes (Husband-Wife, family realities) compared to generic sad poetry or motivational clips. Videos centered around partner understanding and domestic emotional reality ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya' with 1,767 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,675 views) generated roughly 5x to 10x more traffic than typical posts. Generic heartbreak shayari and low-context emotional shorts underperformed significantly.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage love and spousal understanding achieved the highest views (1.7k+ views vs average 150-300 views).
winning_patterns.action: Produce more content revolving around domestic relationship struggles, unspoken expectations between partners, and the evolution of marriage.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable psychological question ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?') drove higher engagement and curiosity clicks.
winning_patterns.action: Use inquiry-based hooks that address everyday domestic or emotional friction.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received minimal traction (19 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly abstract or cliché poetry without a grounded real-life anchor.

weak_patterns.evidence: General self-motivation without a narrative arc ('तुम थके हो… हारे नहीं') resulted in lower baseline views (173 views).
weak_patterns.action: Ground all emotional lessons in a concrete, observable household or relationship moment.
